model.selection: inherited current session model, same setting for all arms
model.metadata_limit: Host does not expose these values; repetition IDs are not RNG seeds.

scope: bounded aircraft model configuration authoring through existing three-layer compiler; synthetic requirements, not official/native SIMLOX equivalence; no training or engine changes

calibration.purpose: check usability and protocol before freeze; do not optimize against formal outcomes
calibration.development_holdout_relation: Different instances and selected combinations inside the same bounded aircraft mechanism family. No unseen-family or cross-domain generalization claim.

arms.A: schema and business requests, one submission, no execution
arms.B: A plus mechanism cards, one submission, no execution
arms.C: B plus public compiler/runtime and trace, initial attempt plus up to two revisions

main.context: fresh per arm/repetition, all 24 tasks share that context
main.case_order: deterministically shuffled by repetition and identical between arms within repetition
main.wall_enforcement: record actual self-reported start/end and controller receipt; flag overruns, do not silently claim enforced

clarification_followup.policy: After sealing primary responses, supply preregistered simulated-user answer to every response that passes clarification prescreen; retain same author context. No grader results are supplied. Separate answered-model completion and required missing-field coverage from first response metrics.
clarification_followup.user_interventions: simulated oracle replies counted separately; not actual user interaction
clarification_followup.single_reply_contains: all and only preregistered answers, supplied together once

repair.source: first-pilot T01-T06 requirements, independent from round2 holdout
repair.initial_models: each compiles and executes but fails independent acceptance

arms.N: receipt only; no compilation or execution
arms.D: compile diagnostics only; no runtime execution or trace
arms.T: trace plus limited preregistered public behavioral probes

evaluation.primary: critical business constraints plus independently hand-derived trace/terminal expectations and selected held-out parameter interventions
evaluation.equivalence: not full canonical model equality; selected harmless ordering and resource-free preparation equivalences supported, not a complete semantic equivalence decision
evaluation.text_responses: automatic field/keyword prescreen plus separately reported group-blinded AI semantic review
evaluation.denominators: 16 model cases, 4 clarification cases, 4 unsupported cases per run; never pool into an executable success rate
evaluation.statistics: descriptive per-case/per-run results; repeated outputs and same-context tasks are dependent, no independent-binomial significance claim

isolation.access_audit: agent-reported file and command logs, not OS-enforced read audit

product_integration.gate: use observed modeling and repair failure modes to specify the user-facing flow; this experiment does not deploy Riffoid or a persistent hosted inference service
